CIVIS TERMS & CONDITIONS
Effective Date: 9 November 2026
Jurisdiction: Republic of Uganda

1. NATURE OF THE SERVICE (NO ADVOCATE–CLIENT RELATIONSHIP)
Civis provides automated legal research assistance grounded in Ugandan legislation and judicial decisions, as well as general-purpose legal document templates. Civis is an information and drafting tool, not a law firm or an enrolled Advocate of the High Court of Uganda under the Advocates Act. Using Civis does not create an advocate–client relationship, and outputs do not constitute formal legal representation or legal advice.

2. ELIGIBILITY & ACCOUNT SECURITY
You must be at least 18 years old and capable of forming a binding contract under the Contract Act, 2010 of Uganda to use Civis. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and verifying your email address.

3. ACCEPTABLE USE & JURISDICTIONS
Civis is designed exclusively for lawful inquiries and document preparation governed by the laws of the Republic of Uganda in English. You must not use Civis to falsify documents, evade law enforcement, infringe third-party rights, or submit unlawful or malicious files.

4. QUOTAS, PLANS & UGX BILLING
New accounts receive a complimentary starter allowance of 20 prompts. Paid subscription plans (Civis Starter, Civis Pro, and Civis Chambers) are billed in Ugandan Shillings (UGX) via Mobile Money (MTN MoMo / Airtel Money) or bank card. A prompt is consumed only when a response begins streaming or a drafting prefill succeeds; any request that fails before the first token is automatically refunded to your balance.

5. GENERATED DOCUMENTS & UPLOADS
Templates and generated Word (.docx) documents are provided on an "as-is" basis. You are solely responsible for reviewing all facts, dates, amounts, and clauses before signing or executing any agreement, notice, or pleading, and for consulting a licensed Ugandan advocate where formal legal representation is required.

6. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
To the maximum extent permitted by Ugandan law, Civis shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, or special damages arising from your reliance on generated answers or documents.

7. GOVERNING LAW
These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Uganda.

CIVIS PRIVACY POLICY
Effective Date: 9 November 2026
Compliance Framework: Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019 (Uganda)

1. DATA WE COLLECT
We collect only the personal data necessary to provide Civis:
• Account Details: Your name, email address, authentication session identifiers, and subscription/quota ledger records.
• Conversations & Drafts: Questions submitted in Research or Drafting mode, template field values, generated .docx files, and optional uploaded documents.
• Technical Diagnostics: Bounded operational metrics (response latency, token counts, and error codes) with personal content and secrets stripped.

2. HOW WE PROTECT & ENCRYPT YOUR DATA
• Encryption at Rest: Template draft values, generated document metadata, and extracted document upload text are encrypted at rest using authenticated symmetric encryption (Fernet/AES).
• Private Object Storage: Generated .docx files and uploaded files are stored in private, owner-scoped object storage buckets and are never publicly addressable.

3. THIRD-PARTY PROCESSING & CROSS-BORDER SAFEGUARDS
To answer legal research queries and extract drafting fields, Civis transmits only the minimum required query context over TLS to our configured AI inference provider and retrieves statutory and judicial passages from Laws.Africa Knowledge Bases. We do not sell your personal data or use your private legal documents to train public foundation models.

4. DATA RETENTION
• Uploaded documents are automatically purged after 30 days or immediately when you delete them.
• Soft-deleted accounts and orphaned storage objects are permanently purged by our automated retention worker.

5. YOUR RIGHTS UNDER UGANDAN LAW
Under the Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019, you have the right to:
• Access & Export: Download a complete JSON archive of your profile, consents, conversations, and document records at any time via "Export account data" (GET /v1/me/export).
• Erasure: Permanently delete individual conversations, generated documents, uploaded files, or your entire account via "Delete account" (DELETE /v1/me), which immediately revokes all active sessions and removes your stored files.
